questions.q: In Oracle Fusion Cloud, where do invoice tolerances, discount defaults, and tax options for a business unit live?
options: Three separate screens, one for each area
On the individual supplier record
In the General Ledger chart of accounts
On a single consolidated page, Manage Payables System Options, scoped per business unit
questions.explain: Fusion consolidates what older Payables products split into several screens into one business-unit-scoped page.

questions.q: What is the purpose of a price or amount tolerance?
options: To define how much variance between the invoice and the matched PO is acceptable before a hold is raised
To set the supplier's payment terms
To calculate withholding tax
To decide which bank account pays the invoice
questions.explain: Tolerances define the acceptable variance between invoice and PO/receipt data before Payables stops the invoice with a hold.

questions.q: A business unit has a 5% price tolerance. An invoice comes in 7% over the PO price. What happens?
options: The invoice is automatically rejected and deleted
The invoice gets a matching hold because it exceeds the tolerance
The invoice validates with no issue
The tolerance is automatically raised to match the invoice
questions.explain: A variance exceeding the configured tolerance raises a matching hold during validation.

questions.q: What does the 'Always take discount' option control?
options: Whether withholding tax applies to the supplier
Whether the invoice requires approval
Whether the available early-payment discount is taken for a supplier regardless of the actual payment date
Whether the invoice is matched to a purchase order
questions.explain: This discount option takes the available discount for a supplier no matter when the invoice is actually paid.

questions.q: Which of the following is a prepayment-related default set on the invoice options area?
options: Settlement days, the number of days added to calculate when a prepayment should settle
Quantity received tolerance
The supplier's business classification
The bank account used for wire transfers
questions.explain: Settlement days and default prepayment terms are prepayment-related defaults configured on invoice options.
